title: Space bound from a halting time bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $T,S\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose every choice word of length exactly $T$ leads to a halted configuration on $x$, and each such run uses at most $S$ work-tape cells in total. Then every choice word, of any length, uses at most $S$ work-tape cells in total on input $x$.
